procedure.method: Independent fresh review of only the explicitly pinned inputs. Read the literal packet, case, rules, rubric, compact method/addendum and five pinned native-evidence manifests; did not follow their unlisted source/input paths. The packet declares no supplied source assets or protected layouts. Verified hashes, byte counts and PNG dimensions for the five manifests and fifteen poster views. Actually opened and visually inspected each exact poster with functions.exec/tools.view_image(detail=original), emitting the original-detail image, sequentially M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in that same three-view order. All fifteen displayed poster images preceded the first deliberate copy-reading/transcription stage and every judgment/score. After that complete viewing pass, read each member from the displayed pixels and retained the first readings below. No image creation/editing, alternative asset, crop, additional reviewer, peer review, fork, resume or ambiguity revisit was used. Helper success was used only for byte/dimension verification, never as proof of semantic viewing. Session identity is not observable and remains null.
